basis.text: No active ABC licence of a type the rules read (Types 41, 42, 47, 48, 61, 75) is on file at 999 Valencia St, so the records do not show what the space is used as now.
The rules have no Planning Code use for the concept, so it was not compared with the last use of the space and a change of use is not established.
Building Code: a restaurant or bar is Assembly Group A-2, and a space for fewer than 50 people is Group B (2022 California Building Code).
basis.code_section: California Building Code 2022 edition, § 303.1.1, § 303.3; San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1.12

basis.text: The rules have no Planning Code use for the concept, so the proposed occupancy group is not established.
The existing occupancy group of the space is not in public records; only plans or an inspection show it. A change of occupancy is not established.

Without what kind of business it is (a bar, a restaurant, a cafe or an entertainment venue) and the existing occupancy group of the space, which only plans or an inspection show, the rules cannot say whether this is a change of use or of occupancy, so they cannot say which building permit applies: insufficient information.
basis.code_section: San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1; Planning Code § 175
